snippet.title: The Scourge (Tai Ương) - Official Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the trailer for The Scourge, a first-person horror puzzle game that immerses you in the heart of Saigon (Vietnam) through urban legends from the 1990s. You'll follow the tragic fate of a family and the main character, who made mistakes in the past and is now haunted by a sinister supernatural force. The Scourge is available now on PC. It is coming to PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox.
